title: Digital infrastructure and employment in services: evidence from sub-Saharan African countries
summary: The paper examines the link between digital infrastructure and employment in the services sector in sub-Saharan Africa, and the conditions under which the link is stronger or weaker.
keyFindings: Digital infrastructure is positively associated with services-sector employment.
The positive effect grows as institutional quality improves.
Poor macroeconomic conditions weaken the effect, and the effect depends on education levels.
methods: Panel data for 45 sub-Saharan African countries, 1996–2017.
